name: docmoot
title: docmoot
blurb: a shared document anyone with the link can write in real time — no login needed, same as a Google Doc share link. sign in and the current text snapshots straight into your own PDS as a custom lexicon record, so the durable copy lives in your repo, not a walled garden. @riziles.bsky.social asked, replying to a "sign this Google Doc" thread, whether there's a way to do this on atproto.
